title: Best Time to Climb Kilimanjaro, Month by Month
excerpt: You can climb Kilimanjaro all year, but the dry months are easier. Here is what each month is like on the mountain.
body:
Kilimanjaro can be climbed in every month, but the weather varies a lot. The main dry seasons are from late June to October and from late December to early March.

## January to early March

Usually dry and clear, a little warmer than mid-year. A very good time to climb, with snow on the summit after the short rains. January and February are popular.

## Mid-March to May

The long rains. Trails are muddy in the forest and cloud is common. Fewer climbers. If you go in this period, the northern [Rongai Route](/blog/kilimanjaro-rongai-route-guide/) is drier, and [Marangu](/blog/kilimanjaro-marangu-route-guide/) offers huts.

## June

The rains fade, the trails dry out. Colder nights start. A good, quieter month.

## July to October

The main dry season and the busiest time on the mountain. Clear skies, cold nights, especially at the higher camps. August is the peak month.

## November

The short rains. Afternoon showers, but often clear mornings. Quiet trails.

## December

The short rains end mid-month. The Christmas and New Year period is popular; book early.

## Temperature

Regardless of month, it can be well below freezing on the summit at night. Your [packing list](/blog/kilimanjaro-packing-list/) matters every season.

## Our advice

The best month is the one that fits your life, as long as you plan enough days. A well-acclimatised climb in November is better than a rushed one in August. Read about [climbing in the rainy season](/blog/kilimanjaro-rainy-season/) or [plan your climb with us](/travel-proposal/).
